description: TACKLE COMMITMENT 3 - RE-CHALLENGE RATE. Commit 0x1441a8a70 refuses a new tackle unless (currentFrame - player[+0x28e0]) >= fps*0.5. That 0.5 s lockout is why a beaten defender stands off after a failed challenge. 0.35 s lets him have a second go. The +0.5 rounding term 8 bytes later shares the same pool cell and is deliberately NOT touched.
